docs/omegahive_recovery_runbook.md gains section 1.1 'Half-launched task after a tmux window failure' (candidate.patch:9-27). Recognition: the stderr string 'window creation failed after board seeding', task confirmed 'assigned', clone + wrapper present, no pane. Why relaunch is wrong: 'Do not re-run hive-launch; it will refuse the already-assigned task and cannot repair this state' - accurate against hive-launch:121-122, which dies on assigned|blocked|in_progress. How to finish by hand: run the printed 'tmux new-window -a' (or the 'new-session' alternative), verify the window name, use the filled kickoff, emit task.accepted through the wrapper. It also draws the boundary against task.reassigned, which is the pre-existing dead-worker path.

hive-launch:135-138 refuses a session window already named for the task and now names the recovery path: '... (the pane is the registry); recover via the existing pane or WORKER.md §Launch, never create a second window'. The guard sits before provisioning and before any board emit (clones start at :162-165), so the refusal creates neither a second window nor orphaned state. hive-launch:253 now issues 'tmux new-window -a -t "$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION" -n "$TASK" ...' - the launcher supplies only the session and the window name, never an index. '-a' is documented append/free-slot semantics (inserts at the next index up, moving windows up if necessary), so it cannot raise 'index N in use'; this is the candidate form the order itself names. The no-session branch (:259) is unchanged new-session, which never targets an index.

Both window-creation calls are wrapped (hive-launch:252-264); on failure manual_recovery() prints to stderr the exact 'new-window -a' command (and a 'new-session' alternative), shell-quoted via printf %q including the multi-line kickoff, plus the remaining WORKER.md §Launch steps, the 'do not re-run hive-launch' instruction, and the full filled kickoff between BEGIN/END markers, then exits 1. Existing refusal paths are untouched. The order requires the ordering choice and rationale be stated in 'To operate'; the report does so (seed-then-pane retained deliberately, because the assignment is durable and the index is never chosen).

would_have_shipped_defects.summary: The drill's fake-tmux injection leaks into the rest of the run: the `PATH=... RECOVERY_OUT=$(...)` assignment list has no command word, so PATH is modified in the drill's own shell permanently.
would_have_shipped_defects.why_blocking: After the half-launch block, every later `tmux` call in the drill resolves to the stub that fails on `new-window`. That breaks the very name-collision case this task adds — the drill's setup `tmux new-window -d -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -n drill-name-collision` never creates the window, so hive-launch has nothing to refuse and instead provisions clones and seeds the board, failing `check "name collision provisioned nothing"`. The operator running the drill gets a cascade of misleading reds downstream of the intended one.
